extraction: Exact original 48-byte VAG header plus unmodified ADPCM payload

entries.embedded_english: We need to get off this beach! Follow me and keep your heads down!
Take out that nest Miller!
Okay, now we need to silence those artillery positions. We need more Marines on this beach soon or this is all going to be over pretty damn quickly.
Okay, lets move up to that bunker!
Now THAT'S close air support!
Squad, regroup on me! We've got to find a way to get a charge on that gun!  Use this trench for cover!
Done.  Now lets get out of here and detonate this thing!
Squad - use the surrounding cover and get to that gun!
Looks like the entrance is right down that trench.
Okay, Listen up, General Smith wants this Island, and we're going to take it for him Marines! We're taking the fight to them  today men! So ready up!
Its about time we saw some major action…
Huh, If we get any, The Navy has been shelling the island for hours.
Yeah and if these crates even get us to the Island!
Sergeant, It's time, get ready to go! hold on to something back there!
Ah man, I hate this part!
Jonesy, you hate every part!
They've put up some barbwire defenses along the beach?!
Ram them at full speed!
You're up, Miller.  Jump down into the trench and plant the charge.
Our boys aren't even making it to the beach!
We’re nearly there Marines, prep your gear and get ready!
Hold up! Polonsky, Miller, make sure this bunker is clear!
This bunker has got to lead under that gun! Polonsky! Miller! Get in there and get a charge on that thing!
Get in there and secure that bunker, Marines!
Red Beach 3 is now open!
Miller! Come on, Sarge wants us back up top!
Oh my god…..that was Garcia's boat…
Holy…..they didn't stand a chance!
Woodpeckers! Find some cover!
Looks like the they are dug in pretty tight! The Artillery must be close! Go!
Move! Move! Move!
Good work Marines, good to be off that beach!
We need to take out those machine gun nests up ahead, or our boys will never clear the beach….
Good work, Marines.   Juding by the sounds, that artillery is just up ahead.
Whooo yeah!!   That's how you do it!
One down, one to go. Lets keep moving.
Heads up! More Japanese incoming! Get to cover!
There's the other gun up ahead! Lets move it!
Watch out for MG positions up ahead.
See the craters?  Use 'em for cover!
Good work, Marines.  Japanese forces are retreating inland. (pause)  Miller,  you do the honours.
Come on Miller.  Haul ass!
Air support closing on target, heads up we're coming in low and fast!
Alright, lets move out, take it slow.. They're waiting for us…
Okay, hold on men, here we go!
Take out that MG nest!
Good work Miller, SQUAD! on me!
Whoah, that was a little too close!
Okay, one more MG nest up ahead! Lets go!
Miller, we've got to clear those MG nests!
Miller you take point, Okay! Lets go!
We're pinned down Sarge! Theres no way through!
Squad on me!
Carter! Call in air support to take out that nest!
This is Carter!... Request immediate air support, Danger close! ….red beach 3!.... MG nest 40 meters south of our position! Over?!
Roger that Carter, we see the target, hold your position!
Okay Marines! Hold up and wait for air support!
Listen up! We’re going to have to clear both these buildings! Split up and get to it!
Miller! Place the charge, andlet's get out of here!
We've got to get to that trench up ahead!
